fichas.title: Wine cellars
fichas.summary: Wine cellars are preferably located below ground on all sides, next to the house, with the north side recommended. The text specifies humidity and temperature conditions, flexible ventilation, low lighting, insulated construction when air conditioning is used, and porous materials for floors, walls, and storage racks. Wines are arranged by temperature gradient: sparkling wines near the floor, white wines in the middle, and red wines higher up. Figures illustrate racks, an air-conditioned cupboard and door, storage temperatures, and cellar plans and sections.
